user_query: I'm organizing a game-themed event for a charity fundraiser. Provide me with the top-rated games for the month and suggest an unsolved Sudoku puzzle for the attendees. Also, generate an image of the unsolved Sudoku in SVG format for us to display on promotional materials.

TaskList.description: 查询本月评分最高的游戏列表
生成一个未解的数独谜题
将未解数独谜题转换为SVG格式的图像
